source_text: הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם בְּנֵי יֵשׁ֧וּעַ וְ/קַדְמִיאֵ֛ל לִ/בְנֵ֥י הוֹדַוְיָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה־׃ס
english_snapshot: The Levites: the sons of Jeshua and Kadmiel[a], of the sons of Hodaviah, seventy-four.

signals.text: Hebrew reads 'Hodaviah'; the parallel in Nehemiah 7:43 has 'Hodevah.'

source_text: וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֣ד יֵשׁ֡וּעַ בָּנָ֣י/ו וְ֠/אֶחָי/ו קַדְמִיאֵ֨ל וּ/בָנָ֤י/ו בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָה֙ כְּ/אֶחָ֔ד לְ/נַצֵּ֛חַ עַל עֹשֵׂ֥ה הַ/מְּלָאכָ֖ה בְּ/בֵ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּנֵי֙ חֵֽנָדָ֔ד בְּנֵי/הֶ֥ם וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם הַ/לְוִיִּֽם־־ס׃
english_snapshot: Then Jeshua[a], his sons and his brothers, and Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, stood together as one to oversee those doing the work in the house of God, along with the sons of Henadad, their sons and their brothers, the Levites.

signals.text: Hebrew: 'the sons of Judah.' Some ancient versions and modern translations read 'the sons of Hodaviah.'

source_text: וַ/יִּגְּשׁ֨וּ אֶל זְרֻבָּבֶ֜ל וְ/אֶל רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽ/אָב֗וֹת וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ נִבְנֶ֣ה עִמָּ/כֶ֔ם כִּ֣י כָ/כֶ֔ם נִדְר֖וֹשׁ לֵֽ/אלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם ו/לא אֲנַ֣חְנוּ זֹבְחִ֗ים מִ/ימֵי֙ אֵסַ֤ר חַדֹּן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר הַ/מַּעֲלֶ֥ה אֹתָ֖/נוּ פֹּֽה־־׀׃
english_snapshot: Then they approached Zerubbabel and the heads of the fathers’ houses and said to them[a], “Let us build with you, for like you we seek your God, and we have been sacrificing to him since the days of Esar-haddon king of Assyria[b], who brought us up here.”

signals.text: Hebrew reads 'and not we are sacrificing'; many understand this as a scribal form for 'and to him we are sacrificing' or otherwise take it idiomatically in a positive sense from the context.

source_text: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֥י בִגְוַ֖י עוּתַ֣י ו/זבוד וְ/עִמּ֖/וֹ שִׁבְעִ֥ים הַ/זְּכָרִֽים׃פ
english_snapshot: And from the sons of Bigvai: Uthai and Zabbud[b][a], and with them seventy males.

signals.text: Some textual traditions and ancient versions reflect a different second name here; the Masoretic Text reads 'Zabbud.'

source_text: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֖י בָּנִ֑י מְשֻׁלָּ֤ם מַלּוּךְ֙ וַ/עֲדָיָ֔ה יָשׁ֖וּב וּ/שְׁאָ֥ל ירמות׃ס
english_snapshot: And from the sons of Bani: Meshullam[a], Malluk, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal[b], and Jeremoth.

signals.text: Jeremoth may reflect a variant vocalization or name-form in some traditions.
